# Hoop (hero), phase 2: DinoKnight 16 materials (sRGB 0..1 of the ramp steps), the board's painted
# faces (textures/board_front.png, board_back.png), the net's chain diamonds (textures/net.png),
# hidden faces deleted (the arms' ends inside the board and the plate). Generated by make_hoop.py.
material new Board --base-color 0.9451 0.9451 0.9176 --no-slot
material new BoardFront --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new BoardBack --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.8039 0.2392 0.2392 --no-slot
material new Steel --base-color 0.3255 0.3451 0.4039 --no-slot
material new Net --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
select Board
material assign Board
active Board
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
material assign BoardFront
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
uv project-from-view back --scale-to-bounds
material assign BoardBack
mode object
material texture BoardFront base-color textures/board_front.png
material texture BoardBack base-color textures/board_back.png
select Rim Clip
material assign Rim
select Plate Arm00 Arm01 Arm10 Arm11
material assign Steel
select Arm00
active Arm00
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9 || normal.y < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select Arm01
active Arm01
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9 || normal.y < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select Arm10
active Arm10
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9 || normal.y < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select Arm11
active Arm11
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9 || normal.y < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select Net0
active Net0
mode edit
select all
uv cylinder-project
mode object
material assign Net
select Net1
active Net1
mode edit
select all
uv cylinder-project
mode object
material assign Net
select Net2
active Net2
mode edit
select all
uv cylinder-project
mode object
material assign Net
material texture Net base-color textures/net.png
select all
shade flat
export hoop.glb
select Board Rim Clip Plate Arm00 Arm01 Arm10 Arm11
export hoop_body.glb --selection
